cases.name: Rachel Ann Jordan
cases.about: Her obituary said She was a homemaker and of the Baptist faith. She loved her family and her dogs and enjoyed collecting things and fishing. She had lived in Tifton for 47 years. Danny Gaskins describes Jordan as a mother-figure to him, and said seeing her at the viewing, made her shooting death that much more real. "Rachel was the kind of person that, she would invite you inside of her home and would sit you down for a nice meal," said Gaskins. Gaskins has known Rachel Jordan and her family for more than 15 years. "If you needed a friend to talk to she would be that person that would give you someone to talk too," said Gaskins.
